01-windows: Two frosted panes slide into each other. The bright overlap is the shared room. Echoes the movable windows in the app.
02-trio: Study, watch and listen overlap, and the white centre is the moment friends share. Says what the product does at a glance.
03-gather: Friends sit around one light. The brightest dot is you, arriving. Reads as "a room full of people".
04-echo: A ring made of sound, with you at the centre. The music and listening-together side of the product.
05-twin: Two interlocked rings: two friends, one shared moment in the glow between them.
06-omega: Omni = all, and the arch is an omega and a doorway. A friend is the light inside. The most ownable silhouette.
